summary: FBRX 2.1.1 Beta: FBRX Cloud AI for FBRX accounts, FBRX Command updates that build again, and a page that fails shows what went wrong instead of a blank window.
notes: FBRX Cloud AI: signed in to an FBRX account, AI models → FBRX Cloud AI → Use for chats. Each edition comes with tokens every month (Standard 1M, Ultra 3M, Black Hole 5M); the page shows what is left and when the month renews. Fabrix keeps its tools, memory and approvals on your computer.
Promo codes: enter one under AI models → FBRX Cloud AI or Settings → FBRX account for extra tokens, an edition for some days, or both.
A page that fails to draw no longer blanks the window: it shows what went wrong with Try again and Reload, and the rest of FBRX keeps working.
An answer with a line the formatting could not place (a heading cut short, say) no longer freezes the chat.

server.summary: FBRX Server 1.2.1: Fabrix in the server console takes your files and hands over what it makes.
notes: Fabrix in the server console: attach files and pictures (or drop or paste them) for the server's agent to read, as in FBRX OS.
What Fabrix makes (documents, drawings) shows under its step, pictures as a thumbnail, each with Download; attached files download the same way.
The server console shows what went wrong with Try again and Reload instead of going blank.
From 1.1: sudo fbrx-server update check, then sudo fbrx-server update commit.

command.summary: FBRX Command 2.1.1: Update now works again, and FBRX Cloud AI is run from the Cloud AI page.
notes: Update now no longer fails at "Building FBRX Command" ('vite' is not recognized). If an update already failed, run Install FBRX Command again: it now sees the build tools are missing and installs them.

Cloud AI (on an account server set up for it): each edition's tokens a month, a budget for the whole service, and per account its own limit, extra tokens, lifting the limit for the month or turning it off.
Promo codes: extra FBRX Cloud AI tokens, Standard or Ultra for some days, or both, for a number of accounts and until a date; see who used each one.
The console shows what went wrong with Try again and Reload instead of going blank.
